extracted_concepts.name: Ratio

extracted_concepts.name: Constant of proportionality

extracted_concepts.name: Absolute value
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Understand ordering and absolute value of rational numbers.

extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Find the greatest common factor of two whole numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Least common multiple
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Find the least common multiple of two whole numbers.

extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Write, read, and evaluate expressions in which letters stand for numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Equivalent expressions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Identify when two expressions are equivalent.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear expression
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Add, subtract, factor, and expand linear expressions with rational coefficients.

extracted_concepts.name: Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Understand solving an equation as a process of reasoning.

extracted_concepts.name: Polygon
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Find the area of polygons and draw polygons in the coordinate plane.

extracted_concepts.name: Right triangle
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Find the area of right triangles and use the Pythagorean Theorem.

extracted_concepts.name: Area
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Find the area of triangles, polygons, and circles.

extracted_concepts.name: Volume
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Find the volume of prisms, cylinders, cones, and spheres.

extracted_concepts.name: Surface area
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Solve problems involving area, volume, and surface area.

extracted_concepts.name: Circumference
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Know the formulas for area and circumference of a circle.

extracted_concepts.name: Circle
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Use formulas for area and circumference of a circle.

extracted_concepts.name: Pythagorean Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Understand and use the Pythagorean Theorem.

extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Describe the effect of dilations, translations, rotations, and reflections.

extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Figures are congruent if obtained by rotations, reflections, and translations.

extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Recognize a statistical question as one that anticipates variability.

extracted_concepts.name: Measures of center
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Give quantitative measures of center such as median and mean.

extracted_concepts.name: Measures of variability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Give quantitative measures of variability such as interquartile range.

extracted_concepts.name: Scatter plot

extracted_concepts.name: Two-way table

extracted_concepts.name: Probability model
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Develop, use, and evaluate probability models.

extracted_concepts.name: Random sampling
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Use random sampling to draw inferences about a population.

extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Work with radicals and integer exponents.

extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Use square root and cube root symbols to represent solutions.
